'''Will Dean''' is a Star Wars CCG player who finished 11th at [[2001 West Virginia State Championship]] on 12 May 2001, according to Mike Adams's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2315">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-05-16-wv-state-tournament-report-5-12-01d2315/ wv-state-tournament-report-5-12-01], DeckTech (Michael "Yoda's Son" Adams, 16 May 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-05-16-wv-state-tournament-report-5-12-01d2315/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
